decisions.reason: A 2018 schlager compilation CD in a shrinking CD market has likely fallen below sales aspirations, so problemistic search points to freeing shelf and catalogue resources for newer releases.
An ongoing illustrated release series builds a collector base and brand identity, and with no clear sign of failure the firm can carry it on existing slack.
Reissued jazz vinyl matches the strong vinyl revival and likely meets or exceeds aspirations relative to comparable retailers.
A multi-disc box set has high margins and long collector appeal, so it is worth keeping despite limited runs and uncertain demand.
A generic compilation CD that was only mentioned rather than featured suggests weak performance against aspirations in a declining format, making it a candidate to drop.
